title: Trader Diary: The $79k Bitcoin Rollercoaster
content:
📉 79,654 → I stare at the chart like it's a Netflix thriller.
💭 78.9k → “Just one more long, I’ll catch the dip.”
🚀 78.5k → Leverage hits 20x, heart rate hits 200 BPM.
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before the hype, or the hype will set your stop‑loss.
question: Who else added more leverage at 78.9k? Be honest 👇
